owner_decision: 8 Oct 2026: hasil analisis sementara disimpan 7 hari setelah selesai atau dibatalkan. Jangan hapus job yang belum selesai, dokumen transaksi, atau bukti yang diperlukan audit. Hasil kedaluwarsa harus diberi keterangan jelas.
scope: A finished staged job (DONE, or FAILED when it stopped) is kept 7 days after it finished; the job status carries retention {days 7, kept_until, KEPT|EXPIRED|NOT_FINISHED}. When expired every reader of the run refuses with CP7_ANALYSIS_RESULT_EXPIRED and the time in DETAIL: pages, page, source check, freshness, full check, plan v2 options/save/preview/apply, Business Report v2 publish, Tanya AI brief, reminders v2. Documents (plan drafts, published reports, reminder sets/claims) stay readable. A running job never expires. cp7_analysis_stage.purge_expired(limit) is private (no grants) and has no schedule yet (the server scheduler is CP7C): for expired finished jobs it removes the intermediates always and the pages only when no document was made from the run; job rows, units, header, page index, capture mark and the retained per-target index stay; one immutable log row per purged job keeps the removed pages' index, bytes and hashes and the documents that kept a run's pages.
client: The staged view says how long the result is kept ("disimpan sampai <WIB> (7 hari sesudah analisis selesai)"); an expired result is not read: the screen says it expired at <WIB> and asks for a new analysis.
browser: Desktop and mobile: a staged run by one click shows the kept-until line; after the run is aged (labelled SYNTHETIC), reopening the last result shows the expired message and reads no page.
synthetic: Labelled SYNTHETIC: the finished job row's updated_at moved back (administrative) to stand for days passing; nothing else is synthetic.
